children: The appointment brings a human resource professional with 32 years of experience to the Coal India subsidiary

Rekha Pandey has taken over as Director (Human Resources) at Mahanadi Coalfields (MCL), a subsidiary of Coal India. Before her appointment, she was serving as General Manager (HR/CSR) at Coal India’s corporate office in Kolkata. Her experience spans human resource management, employee welfare and industrial relations, with previous assignments at Central Coalfields (CCL), another Coal India subsidiary.

Pandey brings 32 years of experience in human resource management. Her career has included responsibilities across employee welfare, industrial relations and other functions associated with managing the workforce.
Her experience in these areas forms the professional background for her new role at MCL, where she will lead the human resource function.
During her career, Pandey has served in various capacities at CCL, where she handled key functions relating to employee welfare and industrial relations.

Her assignments at the subsidiary also covered other aspects of human resource management. These responsibilities have given her experience across multiple areas of workforce administration within the coal sector.
Before moving to MCL as Director (HR), she was General Manager (HR/CSR) at Coal India’s corporate office in Kolkata.
Pandey holds an MBA in Personnel Management from the Xavier Institute of Social Service (XISS), Ranchi. She is also a graduate in Economics.
Her academic qualifications combine personnel management training with a background in economics, alongside her professional experience in human resource management.

As Director (HR), Pandey takes charge of the human resource function at MCL. Her professional background includes employee welfare, industrial relations and human resource management across assignments at Coal India and its subsidiaries.
Her appointment marks a leadership change in the human resource function at the coal-producing subsidiary.
